segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making the time. I had us down to cover the additional service desk seats, the April 15 go-live, and whether you want the coterm through next June.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. We’re at 48 seats today. We need 17 more for the Phoenix team, but two of those folks don’t start until May 6.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, so 65 total, with 15 active on April 15 and the last 2 on May 6. We can set the billing that way. At the current tier, the added seats are $74 per seat per month, prorated to your June 30 renewal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you send me the math on that? Finance will ask why the invoice is split.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. It comes to $2,842 for the April 15 through June 30 period, then the two May seats add $272 through June 30. So the one-time prorated invoice is $3,114 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. We also need the same net-30 terms and the PO number on the invoice. PO is PHX-4472.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. Net 30 stays as-is, and I’ll include PO PHX-4472 on the order form and invoice notes. No change to the master terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, can your team do the admin refresher on April 11? We have managers in three time zones, so 1 p.m. Central works best.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, April 11 at 1 p.m. Central works. I’ll put that in the order notes and send the calendar hold today with the implementation lead included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and Mark Lewis for signature. If we have it by tomorrow morning, we can turn it around this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll get the order form with 17 added seats, the two activation dates, net 30, and PO PHX-4472. I’ll send it to you and Mark by 10 a.m. tomorrow.
